summary: Frontend-only test of the new Full-Period Result panel and SIP/Lumpsum equity curves in /simulator.html (preview URL). For each row I recomputed the numbers myself in the browser from window.NSE_DATA (TRI). Runs: Lumpsum and SIP, each from 2010-01-01 and 2006-01-01, plus the SIP blend. Every displayed CAGR/XIRR, Total Invested and Final Value matched my numbers (CAGR/XIRR within 0.06pp, rupee amounts within 0.6%). This held for all 8 indices and the Custom Blend. Sanity: Nifty 50 lumpsum 2010 = 10.50% CAGR, ₹1.33L. SIP 2010 = 402 installments = ₹1.005Cr invested, Nifty 50 XIRR 11.12%. V20 from 2006 computes from 2009-01-01 (13.31% XIRR, 426 installments) and the other 7 use the full 2006 span. No NaN on the page and no console or page errors. Headers, titles, the grey dashed 'Amount Invested' series (SIP only), the ₹Cr/₹L axis and both hover readouts all behave as specified. Found 4 non-blocking issues.

ui_bugs.issue: setErr() and the Reset handler clear #tbody, #meta and the readouts but not #fpbody, #fpTitle or #fpMeta. After an error (e.g. horizon=30 or weights=80%) or after Reset, the old full-period results stay on screen next to the error status. Verified: 9 stale rows remained.

eqIdx = MS (first trading day of each month), so the curve does not start at the sample start or end at the sample end. Start 2010-01-20: the first equity point is 2010-02-01 at ₹25,000 (lumpsum is re-based to Feb 1, not the start date). End 2026-09-29: the last point is 2026-09-01. As a result the equity readout (Nifty 50 lumpsum ₹1,40,639; SIP Amount Invested ₹1,00,25,000) disagrees with the Full-Period table (₹1.33L; ₹1.005Cr). Fix: always include firstIdx and lastIdx in eqIdx and use firstIdx as the lumpsum base.

issues: The Y-axis bottom tick shows a negative rupee value ('-₹24k') because of the 8% padding when baseZero=false. A portfolio value can't be negative; clamp mn at 0 for ₹ axes.

Rows that use a shorter sub-period (Nifty 50 Value 20 starts on 2009-01-01 when Start=2006-01-01) give no visible hint of this. #fpMeta says 'A single ₹25,000 invested on 2006-01-01', which is misleading for that row. Show the row's actual start date (fp.sd is already computed) or add a footnote.

action_items: Clear #fpbody, #fpTitle and #fpMeta in setErr() and in the Reset handler
Equity curve: include firstIdx and lastIdx in eqIdx (and base the lumpsum on firstIdx) so the curve spans the exact start→end and its final values match the Full-Period table
Clamp the lumpsum equity Y-axis minimum to 0 (no negative ₹ ticks)
Show the per-row start date (fp.sd) in the Full-Period table when it differs from the sample start (V20 inception)
critical_code_review_comments: fpIndex SIP: the returned sd is firstNN(k), not the first installment actually invested. That is fine today but should be used for display.
sipAnchorsFull and the rolling SIP anchor generation duplicate the 1st/15th anchor loop; extract a helper.

The SIP 'Amount Invested' ramp counts every anchor, including dates where some index (V20 pre-2009) had no data, so the V20 line and the ramp use different bases in 2006 runs. Acceptable, but worth a legend note.

success_rate.frontend: 95% (all 8 requested checks pass; 4 secondary issues found)

context_for_next_testing_agent: Static page; window.NSE_DATA is global (dates, tri, price, order, labels), so expected values can be recomputed in page.evaluate. Default mode on load is SIP, start 2012-01-01. Latest data date is 2026-09-29. Verified numbers: Lumpsum 2010 N50 10.50%/₹1.33L, blend 17.73%; SIP 2010 N50 11.12%, ₹1.00Cr invested, blend 18.22%/₹5.57Cr; SIP 2006 V20 13.31% (₹1.06Cr invested, from 2009-01-01). Retest the stale fpbody after error/reset and the equity curve endpoints.
